description.p: Library that defines common error values, messages, and common runtime functionality for all GnuPG components. Among these are GPG, GPGSM, GPGME, GPG-Agent, libgcrypt, pinentry, SmartCard Daemon and possibly more in the future.
It will likely be renamed "gpgrt" in the future.
This package contains the headers and other files needed to compile against this library.
